desc:
Welcome to Prison Brainrot Tycoon — a chill, funny, and slightly chaotic tycoon game where brainrot characters have been locked up… and YOU run the prison! 😈

Build your own prison from the ground up, unlock new cells, upgrades, and areas, and watch the brainrots do what they do best… rot 🤪
💰 Earn money
💰 Offline Coin Earnings  
🏗️ Build & upgrade your prison
😂 Troll other players (or just vibe)
⚡ Unlock cool items & boosts
😎 Play at your own pace — no stress, just brainrot

This is a more relaxed tycoon where you can build, chill, and have fun without sweating. Whether you want to grind, flex your prison, or just mess around with friends.

Major Update 2026-08-21
🤖 New Robotics Workshop & Testing Area  
⚡ Random Income Events  
🎯 Daily Quests & Rewards  
💤 Offline Coin Earnings  
👥 Friend Income Boosts  
🧲 Lucky Coin Magnet Game Pass  
💰 Improved Coin Packs & Server Gifts  
✨ New Building Animation

👉 Like the game and join the group for the latest news and updates!
